facts.label: O que estava acontecendo
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação em andamento e when + passado simples para a ação curta: I was hanging the laundry when I heard a noise.

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Para uma ação em andamento no passado, use was/were + verbo com -ing: I was hanging the laundry. The cat was chasing a bird. Use was com I, he, she, it e were com you, we, they.

facts.label: When
facts.sub: Use when para ligar a ação em andamento à ação curta que a interrompeu: I was hanging the laundry when I heard a noise. Depois de when, o verbo fica no passado simples, como heard ou jumped.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We use was/were + -ing for an action in progress.
We say “I was hang the laundry”.
After when, we often use the past simple.
items.why: Yes: when I heard a noise.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We use was/were + -ing for an action in progress. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I was hang the laundry”. → Falso (We say I was hanging.)
After when, we often use the past simple. → Verdadeiro (Yes: when I heard a noise.)

pages.title: A quiet yard · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cloudy afternoon on a quiet street in Toronto. Smoke rises from an old chimney. Kara stands in her yard with a basket. Wet clothes hang on a long line. Her neighbor Paulo stops his car. Kara points to the roof.
“Paulo, look! There’s a cat on my roof!” says Kara. “When did it get up there?” says Paulo. “I was hanging the laundry when I heard a noise.” says Kara.
